title: Gemstones
summary: Hypixel's gemstones - mined in the Crystal Hollows in five tiers, set into the gemstone slots of 499 items at the Gemstone Grinder for Health, Mining Speed, Strength and more.

s.x: : every gemstone block (stained glass) you mine drops a
gem of its kind. Many items (499 of them, Hypixel's) have
; a gem set into one gives the item its stat.

rows.x: Everywhere in the Crystal Hollows (red glass)
Small rare veins anywhere above the Magma Fields (magenta glass)
Crit Damage, Fishing Speed, Foraging Fortune, Farming Fortune

s.x: 80 of a tier craft one of the next (
). A better gem gives more, and so does a rarer item: a Fine Ruby is +4 Health on a Common item and +14 on a Mythic one. Hypixel's whole table is used (from NEU).
An item's slots show under its stats as a row like

: the symbol is the slot's gem (or kind: ⚔ Combat, ☤ Defensive, ✦ Mining, ❂ Universal), the brackets the gem's tier (gray empty, white Rough, green Flawed, blue Fine, purple Flawless, gold Perfect), dark when the slot is locked. A gem's bonus shows on the stat line in pink:
A slot for one gemstone takes only that gem; a
slot takes Ruby, Amethyst, Sapphire, Jasper or Onyx,

Some slots are open from the start; the others cost coins and gemstones to unlock (Hypixel's costs: 50,000 coins and 20 Fine Jade for a drill's first Jade slot, up to 250,000 coins and Flawless gems for Combat slots).
runs the Gemstone Grinder. Put an item in:
a locked slot to unlock it (its coins and gems are taken).
an open, empty slot to set your best gem from your inventory that fits it.
a full slot to take its gem back out, for Hypixel's price: 1 coin for Rough, 100 Flawed, 10,000 Fine, 100,000 Flawless, 500,000 Perfect.
Not yet: Perfect gems' Gemstone Crystals, Gemstone Chambers, chisel slots and Fossils, and the Divine rarity's column.
